label.purpose: States, filters, timestamps, and compact values.

motion.name: radar-cap
motion.purpose: Maximum topology liveness when visible and not static.

components.name: Mode Tab
components.description: Square, keyboard-roving navigation for the three operational modes.
components.css: .ds-mode-tab { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.35 0.014 24); background: oklch(0.195 0.011 24); color: oklch(0.91 0.009 45); font: 650 .75rem/1.3 SFMono-Regular, monospace; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-mode-tab:hover { border-color: oklch(0.60 0.010 45); } .ds-mode-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.62 0.205 26); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Label
components.description: Text-first state marker with a geometric dot.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.74 0.075 148); color: oklch(0.74 0.075 148); background: oklch(0.155 0.010 24); font: 650 .75rem/1.3 SFMono-Regular, monospace; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-status i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Agent Row
components.description: A dense selectable assignment row with explicit lifecycle copy.
components.css: .ds-agent { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 4px 12px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.35 0.014 24); background: oklch(0.155 0.010 24); color: oklch(0.91 0.009 45); text-align: left; } .ds-agent small { color: oklch(0.73 0.010 45); } .ds-agent b { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; align-self: center; color: oklch(0.74 0.075 148); font: 650 .75rem SFMono-Regular, monospace; } .ds-agent:hover { background: oklch(0.195 0.011 24); } .ds-agent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.62 0.205 26); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: A visible-label search control for the local fleet projection.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">FILTER TASKS<input type="search" placeholder="Agent, task, or workstream"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: oklch(0.73 0.010 45); font: 650 .75rem SFMono-Regular, monospace; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.35 0.014 24); background: oklch(0.115 0.009 24); color: oklch(0.91 0.009 45); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.62 0.205 26); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Topology Node
components.description: An accessible agent node bound to a real workstream hub.
components.css: .ds-node { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border: 0; background: oklch(0.115 0.009 24); color: oklch(0.62 0.205 26); font: 650 .75rem SFMono-Regular, monospace; text-align: left; } .ds-node i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.115 0.009 24); background: currentColor; } .ds-node small { color: oklch(0.73 0.010 45); } .ds-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.62 0.205 26); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A captain reads this interface like a well-made technical plotting desk: a dark physical field, fine registration lines, compact labels, restrained signal color, and one meaningful spatial model.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, square-edged, broadcast-technical composition with varied spacing rhythm.
Flowline is the default silhouette; topology becomes the dominant live-operations silhouette.
Semantic HTML, CSS, and inline SVG implement the approved ingredients.
Motion is limited to state transitions, a restrained joining signal, and capped radar liveness.

rules.name: The Rare Crimson Rule
rules.body: Crimson marks a state transition, active selection, or focus. It never fills inactive surfaces.

rules.name: The Written State Rule
rules.body: Color never carries lifecycle meaning alone.

rules.name: The Tonal Elevation Rule
rules.body: Higher operational surfaces are lighter, not blurrier.

dos: Do open on Flowline and keep whole-company scope selected by default.
Do cap continuous radar liveness at 12 FPS, pause it while hidden, and persist static mode.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS admin dashboard from oversized metric cards and repeated identical card grids.
Don't treat append-only status entries as current truth.
Don't expose private report bodies, prompt files, raw local paths, secrets, or credential values.
